tasks.label: Tvinoferma: Windows build (isolated)
tasks.detail: Builds the current checkout with a separate app/data/vault namespace. The task allows a dirty worktree and records its fingerprint; Windows isolation still needs manual acceptance.

tasks.label: Tvinoferma: Run latest Windows build (isolated)
tasks.detail: Starts only the latest isolated local build after checking its profile metadata and SHA-256.

tasks.label: Tvinoferma: Windows build (shared current data)
tasks.detail: Danger: uses the main account/data/vault profile. Requires typing the backup confirmation phrase; close the stable app before running the test EXE.

tasks.label: Tvinoferma: Run latest Windows build (shared current data)
tasks.detail: Danger: starts an EXE that reads and can modify current data, vault and cloud settings. Requires a separate confirmation.

inputs.description: This build uses the real profile and can modify its data/vault. Close the stable app and make independent backups first. Type exactly: I_HAVE_BACKUP_AND_ACCEPT_SHARED_DATA
